_about: Shared test set for comparing feeling spaces. Each entry is something a visitor might say. 'para' marks paraphrases of the same feeling (should land together); 'opposites' lists pairs that should land far apart.

feelings.text: My grandmother passed away last month.
I lost my grandma recently and I miss her.
We won! We actually won the championship!
Our team just took the title, I can't believe it!
I feel peaceful and slow tonight.
Everything is quiet and still, I'm at ease.
I'm furious about how things are going.
I am so angry I could scream.
I'm nervous about my exams next week.
My finals are coming and I can't stop worrying.
Everyone I love is in this room right now.
I'm surrounded by the people who matter most to me.
I feel alone even in this crowd.
Nobody here really knows me.
I think next year is going to be better.
Things are finally starting to look up.
I miss home and my family far away.
I wish I was back in my hometown.
First snow of the year on the walk here.
I saw the snow start falling and just stopped to watch.
I'm so tired, I've been working nonstop.
I haven't slept properly in days.
The concert is about to start and I can't wait!
I'm buzzing, this night is going to be amazing!
I'm just thankful to be here.
I feel lucky for everything I have.
I'm scared about what's going to happen to us.
The future honestly frightens me.
This song reminds me of summers when I was a kid.
It takes me back to being young with my friends.
I just want to dance and be silly.
I feel goofy and light, like a kid again.
I'm fine. Just here.
Nothing special, it's a normal day.
The trees are blooming and it's warm out.
Flowers everywhere, the sun is finally back.
My best friend lied to me.
Someone I trusted went behind my back.
I finished my thesis today.
I finally did the hard thing I've been working toward.
